rationale: The workflow already implements dependency/build caching extensively via actions/cache/restore and actions/cache/save with lockfile-keyed keys (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE is already satisfied). The most directly matching evidence, P-LIT-FAIL-FAST (changing fail-fast: false to fail-fast: true on the build-caches matrix), is contraindicated here: each matrix entry builds an independent cache for a distinct OS/toolchain/target combination, so every matrix outcome is required to preserve the intended cache coverage; cancelling remaining builds on one failure would leave platforms without caches. No other pattern has clear prerequisites met: P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT requires representative successful-duration history to set a meaningful limit, which is not available from the provided context, and environment/reuse patterns either duplicate existing caching or lack repository-specific applicability. Therefore no supported, coverage-preserving change applies.
